reason.journal: the journal isn't available on your desktop
reason.tag_not_found: the tag no longer exists on your desktop
reason.no_journal: there is no journal to add it to
reason.entry_trashed: the entry was moved to Trash on your desktop
reason.name_taken: that name is already in use
reason.changed_on_desktop: it was changed on your desktop in the meantime
reason.absent: it isn't available on your desktop
reason.empty_base: your desktop already has content for it that this edit would overwrite
reason.journal_locked_or_invisible: the journal isn't available on your desktop
reason.target_not_writable: the entry can't be edited on your desktop
